description:
Create, list and show thread files at threads/<Kind>/<Name>.md, where Kind is Projects, Processes or Topics.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list thread files, open threads only by default
  show THREAD [--json] — show one thread file
  new --name NAME --kind KIND --category CATEGORY [--currency CODE] [--rate N] — create a thread file

Args:
  QUERY   optional fuzzy search; results ranked by similarity
  THREAD  thread name or 'Kind/Name', e.g. Projects/Northwind

Flags:
  list:
    --all            include paused and closed threads
    --json           JSON output
  show:
    --json           JSON output
  new:
    --name NAME      required; becomes the filename; no '/', must not start with '.'
    --kind K         required; project|process|topic (stored under Projects, Processes or Topics)
    --category C     required; professional|personal|voluntary
    --currency CODE  3-letter ISO; the default currency for `hours`; makes the thread billable
    --rate N         default hourly rate for `hours`; needs --currency

Examples:
  ["list", "northwind", "--all"]
  ["show", "Projects/Northwind", "--json"]
  ["new", "--name", "Northwind", "--kind", "project", "--category", "professional", "--currency", "ZAR", "--rate", "1500"]

Notes:
  There is no close or delete subcommand. To close a thread, edit its frontmatter: set status: closed and ended: YYYY-MM-DD. Nothing moves.
  Exit 1 means one of: the thread already exists, an empty or invalid name, or --rate without --currency.
